⚡ Quick start — 2 steps

  1. Phone: v2.1 APK install karo (purane kisi bhi version ke upar seedha update — signature same, account/trades as-is) → app kholo → universe khud halal commodities par switch ho jayega (crypto auto-purge).
  2. Users kaise aayen: aap ☰ → Owner Control se naya invite code generate karo → code sirf apne user ko bhejo → wo Register kare → aapko notification aayega → ✓ APPROVE dabao (login chalu) → phir ▶ ENABLE TRADING dabao (trading chalu). Dono steps par aapko notification milta hai.
  3. Real MT5 data (optional): PC par MetaTrader5 + pip install MetaTrader5 + python mt5-bridge.py → app Settings > MT5 DATA FEED me PC ka URL dalo — candles phir aapke MT5 broker se.

☪️ Halal mode: sirf physical commodities (metals/energy/agri) — crypto/forex/indices removed. 🔐 Security: invite code kahin pre-written nahi · registration PENDING until APPROVE · trading OFF until aap ENABLE TRADING dabao · sirf pehla account = ADMIN. 3C MASTER (M5): body ≥ 70% · 5-candle window · SL opposite extreme · BE @+1R · TP @+3R · Data: halal commodities futures feed / MT5 bridge · Paper trading only.
